title:
[Crash] System.ObjectDisposedException: Cannot access a disposed object.
Object name: 'System.Timers.Timer'.
author: vndnua
body_snippet:
## Crash Report

### Exception
**Type:** `System.ObjectDisposedException`
**Message:** Cannot access a disposed object.
Object name: 'System.Timers.Timer'.

### Stack Trace
```
   at void System.Timers.Timer.Start()
   at void mRemoteNG.Config.Connections.Multiuser.RemoteConnectionsSyncronizer.OnUpdateCheckFinished(object sender, ConnectionsUpdateCheckFinishedEventArgs eventArgs) in D:/a/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG/Config/Connections/Multiuser/RemoteConnectionsSyncronizer.cs:line 99...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Fixed in `5e65420` — the `RemoteConnectionsSyncronizer.OnUpdateCheckFinished()` was calling `_updateTimer.Start()` after the timer had already been disposed during shutdown.

Added a `_disposed` flag that is set in `Dispose()` and checked before `Start()`.

Fix is in the upcoming nightly. Thank you for the crash report! 🙏
